answer: terrace sets each key’s voting weight to the square of its uninterrupted epochs of distinct work approved by wharf and logged on dune; histories cannot be transferred or combined. Ten clones matching one 100-epoch honest key need 32 approved epochs each: 320 key-epochs, not 100, with no sharing across parallel keys. Adding clones raises the total; fresh keys start at zero, so honest newcomers pay no operator surcharge.
